caption: The drawing depicts a single object that resembles a dome-shaped or bell-like form, placed centrally on a neutral beige or off-white background. The upper portion of the object is light brown in color, with a diamond or crisscross pattern covering its surface, giving a textured appearance. The lower portion, forming a band around the base, is light greenish-gray and is decorated with an embossed or raised pattern of swirling, leaf-like motifs, and diagonal lines. The base is outlined with a thin dark line, and there is a small circular opening at the top center of the object. There are no other objects, figures, or features present in the drawing. The artist's signature, "Francis Law Durand," appears in small letters in the lower right corner.
title: Petticoat
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
